# 形成与条件是一个关系项的两种角色：生作为生的条件，生由生给予 / Formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum: life as a condition of life, and life given by life

## 主张 Claim

把依存网与流读作一类关系项（Web.roles、Flow.roles）：一个形成在零水平上作为条件，没有谁依存、汲取、从它取用或向它给予；一个条件从不活跃，不依存、不汲取、不取用也不给予。这样读，依存网保持支持、Dependent、条件的更新与消耗、形成的类、侵蚀、逐步读法中活的事件、生起与不息生成；流保持取用与给予、平衡、家族的取用者与补充者，以及不止地更多；共同参与与相互作用两种估值的连通不变。其中曾活跃的形成既不体现也不承担自身。一个关系项体现（Embodied），当它恰在活跃时以正的水平作为条件而在；它承担自身（SelfBearing），当它活跃时以正的需要依存于自身的水平。在 Dependent 之下：承担自身的关系项活跃时作为条件而在；依存于体现关系项（正需要）的形成只在该关系项活跃时活跃；活动沿每条这样的依存链传递，所以一个在某步不活跃的关系项在该步终结每个依存链到达它的形成；在需要为一时消耗体现的关系项就是终结它；在承担自身的体现关系项终结之步汲取它，断裂它自身的依存，不论是否另有形成依存于它，所以该汲取事件不是 living。在只有活跃形成给予的平衡流中，体现的关系项只经由另一个活跃形成的给予而生起。汲取承担自身的关系项，与它的每个活跃事件相互作用：蜜蜂与花各自依存于自身与对方并汲取对方，彼此更新，每个事件都是 living，没有第三个条件，相互作用读法就连通，G0 在那里恰为种子加两项中立；各自只依存于对方时，共同参与与相互作用都不把蜜蜂与花关联起来。狐依存于它吃的兔，随兔一同终结，它的汲取断裂兔自身的依存；一代代形成不止地生起，每一代由前一代给予。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Read webs and flows with one kind of relatum (Web.roles, Flow.roles): a formation stands at level zero as a condition, and nothing depends on it, draws on it, takes from it or gives to it; a condition is never active, and depends on, draws on, takes from and gives to nothing. So read, a web keeps support, Dependent, the renewal and consumption of conditions, the classes of formations, undermining, the living events of the stepwise reading, arising and unceasing generation; a flow keeps what is taken and given, balance, the takers and renewers of a family, and more without end; and the co-participation and interaction valuations keep their connection. In this reading no formation active at some step is embodied or bears on itself. A relatum is embodied (Embodied) when it stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active; it bears on itself (SelfBearing) when, while active, it depends on its own level at a positive need. Under Dependent: a relatum bearing on itself stands as a condition while active; a formation depending on an embodied relatum at a positive need is active only while that relatum is; activity passes along every chain of such dependence, so a relatum not active at a step ends there every formation whose chain reaches it; consuming an embodied relatum at a need of one ends it; drawing on an embodied relatum that bears on itself, across the step at which it ends, breaks its own dependence whether or not any other formation depends on it, so the drawing event is not living. In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it. Drawing on a relatum that bears on itself interacts with each of its active events: a bee and a flower, each depending on itself and on the other and drawing on the other, renew each other, every event is living, and with no third condition the interaction reading is connected, so that G0 there is exactly a seed with both neutralities; where each depends only on the other, neither co-participation nor interaction relates the bee to the flower. A fox depending on the hare it eats ends with it, and its eating breaks the hare's own dependence; generation after generation arises without end, each given by the one before. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- Embodied 与 SelfBearing 是对具体关系项的表示前提：遗骸在活动之后仍作为条件，水这样的条件在而不活跃，都不体现；哪些关系项体现、一个形成是否承担自身，是应用义务。 / Embodied and SelfBearing are representational premises about particular relata: remains stand as conditions after activity ends, and a condition such as water stands without being active, so neither is embodied; which relata are embodied, and whether a formation bears on itself, are application duties.
- Dependent：形成只在当下依存的条件支持时活跃（不含缓冲、储备与滞后）。 / Dependent: a formation is active only where the conditions it then depends on support it (buffers, reserves and lags are left out).
- 生由生给予需要流平衡依存网，并且只有活跃的形成给予（Acting）。 / Life from life needs the flow to balance the web, and only active formations to give (Acting).
- 估值的结果用逐步读法的 living；相互作用是公开的对应纪律，不是展开的推论。 / The valuation results use the stepwise reading of living; interaction is a disclosed correspondence discipline, not a consequence of the unfolding.

第四次独立审查（H14）指出，Web 与 Flow 把形成与条件分为两类，省略了“生作为生的条件”：父母与后代、森林与林下、群落与学习者，只能经由代理条件表示。按非二元方法（先说明同一生成展开中的关系怎样形成、持续和改变，再说明行动者与承受者怎样在其中分化），本结果把形成与条件读作一个关系项的两种角色，两类读法是没有形成作为条件的特例。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。作者把“生由生给予”（Embodied.arises_given）与“生作为生的条件”（active_of_bearing、coextinct）读作原话中两个“生”之间关系的一种形式内容：第二个“生”（生起）由另一个生命的活动给出，生命以其他生命为条件（作者的诠释，AI 论证）；它不替代 Ren 的原话，也不推出它是好的。Embodied.ending_breaks 使在一个承担自身的生命终结之步汲取它的事件不是 living；是否应如此属于 Ren 对生生的读法。 / The fourth independent review (H14) found that Web and Flow split formations and conditions into two kinds, omitting life as a condition of life (parents and young, a forest and its understory, a community and its learners), which could be represented only through a proxy condition. Following the nondual method (first say how relations in one becoming unfold, form, persist and change, then how actors and patients differentiate within them), this result reads formations and conditions as two roles of one relatum, the two-kind reading being the special case in which no formation is a condition. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads “life given by life” (Embodied.arises_given) and “life as a condition of life” (active_of_bearing, coextinct) as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 of those words: the second 生, arising, is given by another life's activity, and lives are conditions of lives (the author's interpretation, an AI argument); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. Embodied.ending_breaks makes an event drawing on a life that bears on itself, across the step at which that life ends, not living; whether it should be belongs to Ren's reading of 生生.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

耗散之下的一类读法：生由生给予时给予者的代价；缓冲、储备与休眠之下的共灭；遗骸与形成的跨步关系；一类读法保持 Acting 与 Taking；终结承担自身的生命是否计入不 living（Ren）；生作为生的条件与“更多”的关系。 / The one-kind reading under dissipation, where giving life costs the giver; coextinction under buffers, reserves and dormancy; the relation across steps between remains and the formation; keeping Acting and Taking under the one-kind reading; whether ending a life that bears on itself counts against living (Ren); the relation of life as a condition of life to “more”.
